TRACK_CLEANER.TITLE: Track Cleaner
TRACK_CLEANER.BLOCK_STATION_DOC: Hides the station that is playing now from every web radio list and moves on to the next item of the queue (or stops if there is none).
TRACK_CLEANER.REMOVE_TRACK: Delete the playing file from disk
TRACK_CLEANER.REMOVE_TRACK_DOC: Moves on to the next item (or stops) and deletes the file that was playing. Works only inside the music folders set below.
TRACK_CLEANER.REMOVE_TRACK_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: The file that is playing now will be deleted from the disk. This cannot be undone.
TRACK_CLEANER.STATS: Blocked by you: {manual}. Found dead: {dead}. Stations known to the checker: {known}.
TRACK_CLEANER.FILTER_DOC: Removes blocked and dead stations from the web radio lists and from search. Your own lists (My Web Radios, Favourites) are never filtered.
TRACK_CLEANER.AUTO_CHECK_DOC: Looks for stations that no longer deliver a stream. The plugin itself reads the radio screen and the folders on it, so you do not have to open anything.
TRACK_CLEANER.CHECK_HOUR_DOC: Local time. A random delay of up to 20 minutes is added.
TRACK_CLEANER.FAIL_THRESHOLD_DOC: A station is blocked only after this many checks in a row failed, so a short outage does not hide a good station.
TRACK_CLEANER.CONCURRENCY: Stations checked at the same time
TRACK_CLEANER.CONCURRENCY_DOC: Lower is gentler on the network and on the player.
TRACK_CLEANER.TIMEOUT: Seconds to wait for a station
TRACK_CLEANER.TIMEOUT_DOC: A station that does not answer within this time counts as failed.
TRACK_CLEANER.CHECK_NOW_DOC: Reads the radio screen, then checks the stations in the background and reports the result.
TRACK_CLEANER.UNBLOCK_DEAD_DOC: Shows them again. They are checked again at the next check.
TRACK_CLEANER.UNBLOCK_MANUAL: Unblock all stations blocked by me
TRACK_CLEANER.UNBLOCK_MANUAL_DOC: Removes every station you blocked with the button above.
TRACK_CLEANER.UNBLOCK_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Every station you blocked will appear in the lists again.
TRACK_CLEANER.ROOTS: Music folders where deletion is allowed
TRACK_CLEANER.ROOTS_DOC: Full paths separated by commas, for example /mnt/HDD. Empty means deleting is switched off. Files outside these folders and files that are not audio are never deleted.
TRACK_CLEANER.ROOTS_FOUND: Detected on this system (type one or more manually):
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_NOT_RADIO: No web radio station is playing
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_BLOCKED: Station blocked and removed from the lists: {title}
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_NO_ROOTS: Deleting is switched off: set the music folder in the settings first
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_OUTSIDE_ROOTS: Not deleted: the file is outside the allowed folders
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_NO_FILE: Not deleted: the file is missing or is not an audio file
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_REMOVE_FAILED: NOT deleted from disk, see the log
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_CHECK_EMPTY: Nothing to check yet: no station was found on the radio screen
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_CHECK_NETWORK: Almost every station failed: this looks like a network problem, nothing was changed
TRACK_CLEANER.TOAST_SCAN_STARTED: Reading the radio lists, the check starts right after
